## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] `make audit`
- [ ] Relevant native tests or desktop/narrow-screen website checks

Record results, skips, and limitations. Use reviewed sample data in screenshots.

## Documentation and publication

- [ ] Updated the relevant README/feature inventory when behavior changed
- [ ] Reviewed staged files for secrets, local paths, build output, and private data
- [ ] No signing material or unreviewed raw captures included
